scope: Aggregation of every typed blocker recorded in the sealed receipt corpus under the declared scan roots, grouped by the blocker string verbatim and ranked by the declared unblock_value formula. Each gap binds the receipts it was read from by content hash. A gap's rank asserts how many declared problems or physics family groups it blocks and how deep the block occurs; it asserts nothing about how hard the missing capability is to build, nor about the mathematics behind it.
